{{Article header|deck=The actionable checklist for gaining access to Felicity Farseer — for location, capabilities, blueprints, and other reference details, see the Engineer article.}}

This Field Procedure covers only the steps to unlock [[Felicity Farseer]]. For the Engineer's location, specialties, available blueprints, experimental effects, and reference details, see [[Felicity Farseer]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Felicity Farseer]]'s Engineer services at [[Farseer Inc]] in [[Deciat]].

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* '''Discovery:''' Felicity Farseer is listed through '''public data sources''' and does not require a referral from another Engineer.
* '''Invitation:''' Reach the Pilots Federation '''Exploration rank of Scout''' or higher.
* Reach '''Scout''' or higher in Exploration Rank.
* Obtain '''1 unit of [[Meta-Alloys]]'''.
}}
== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Reach '''Scout''' or higher in Exploration Rank.
# Obtain '''1 unit of [[Meta-Alloys]]'''.
# Travel to '''Farseer Inc''' in [[Deciat]].
# Donate the Meta-Alloy to Felicity Farseer.
# Enter the Engineer workshop and begin increasing your reputation with her.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Felicity Farseer]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at their workshop.}}
